papers.title: Let's Play Across Cultures: A Large Multilingual, Multicultural Benchmark for Assessing Language Models' Understanding of Sports (CultSportQA, EMNLP 2025)

coauthors.name: Punit Kumar Singh
coauthors.affiliation: Indian Institute of Technology Patna, India
coauthors.relevance_evidence: First author of CultSportQA, 'a benchmark designed to assess LMs' understanding of traditional sports across 60 countries and 6 continents, encompassing four distinct cultural categories'; also first author of arXiv 2606.19727 'NRITYAM: Language Models Meet Art and Heritage of Dance' - a second cultural-heritage LLM evaluation work.

coauthors.name: Akash Ghosh
coauthors.affiliation: Indian Institute of Technology Patna, India
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Repeated author on cultural-knowledge LLM benchmarks: 'SANSKRITI: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models' Knowledge of Indian Culture', 'DRISHTIKON: A Multimodal Multilingual Benchmark for Testing Language Models' Understanding on Indian Culture' and 'VIRAASAT: Traversing Novel Paths for Indian Cultural Reasoning', in addition to CultSportQA. Email printed in arXiv HTML of 2509.19274 (DRISHTIKON).

coauthors.name: Sriparna Saha
coauthors.affiliation: Indian Institute of Technology Patna, India
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Senior author of CultSportQA and of DRISHTIKON ('Multimodal Multilingual Benchmark for Testing Language Models' Understanding on Indian Culture') and SANSKRITI; leads the IIT Patna AI-NLP-ML group's line of work on evaluating cultural knowledge and cultural bias in LLMs/VLMs. Email printed in arXiv HTML of 2509.19274.

coauthors.name: Haiqin Yang
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Corresponding author of CultSportQA (address printed in the arXiv HTML: 'Corresponding authors: yanghaiqin@sztu.edu.cn'), and co-author of arXiv 2606.19727 'NRITYAM: Language Models Meet Art and Heritage of Dance' - two separate works on evaluating LLMs against cultural traditions.

coauthors.name: Jose G Moreno
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Corresponding author on CultSportQA, but an arXiv author search for his other work returns no further culture- or values-oriented LLM papers; his other IIT Patna collaboration (COSMMIC, 2506.15372) is multilingual Indian summarization with no cultural-values dimension. Rejected under the gate that co-authorship on the shared paper alone is not grounds.

coauthors.name: Kitsuchart Pasupa
coauthors.affiliation: King Mongkut's Institute of Technology Ladkrabang, Thailand
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Besides CultSportQA his nearest works are 'When Meaning Isn't Literal: Exploring Idiomatic Meaning Across Languages and Modalities' and 'When Meaning Travels: A Granular Lens on Hybrid-MoE's Role in Idiomatic Understanding for Language Models' - cross-lingual idiomatic semantics, not culture, cultural values or value alignment. Rejected.

coauthors.name: Syukron Abu Ishaq Alfarozi
coauthors.relevance_evidence: arXiv author search returns no cultural- or values-related work other than the shared CultSportQA paper; co-authorship alone is not grounds.
